# Learning by refutation

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> Every learner has an open course refuting each of its claims; no record fixes the next value. In a world held by a list the refutations are bounded, coming to rest is unrefuted and happens only there, and when is not registered; learning over classes is the same learning.

`learning-by-refutation` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F11

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

A course o : Nat → O is a sequence of registered values (such as the registration of a determined law's orbit); record o t is its record before step t, latest first; a learner is any claim pred : List O → Option O made from a record; a claim is refuted (Refuted) when it claims a value and the registered value differs; a hypothesis holds on a course (Holds) when it is refuted at no step. With no premise: for every course and step t, given two values, two courses share its record before t and take the one and the other value at t, and a claim made from that record is not right on both (no_record_fixes_next), and with values decided is refuted on one of them (claim_refuted_on_one); both are courses of worlds held by a list (holdFrom_lasso, no_record_fixes_next_finite). For every learner and every other moving each value, the diagonal course diagonal pred other x refutes each of its claims (diagonal_refutes), so on it the learner does not, from any step on, claim at every step and be right (diagonal_unrested); it is the registration of a law keeping its record, whose configurations no list holds (record_diagonal, diagonal_open). Learning by refutation (indexOn, learner: hypotheses H in order, moving on exactly where the one held is refuted; values decided) never passes a hypothesis that holds: where H j holds the index is at most j (index_le_of_holds) and the learner is not refuted at arbitrarily late steps (refutations_not_recurring); every hypothesis passed was refuted on the record at some step (refuted_before); one record gives one hypothesis and one claim (learner_through_record). Lassos (Lasso o i q: repeating from step i with period q + 1): where a determined law's orbit is held by a list l, every registration of it is a lasso with i + q + 1 ≤ l.length (lasso_of_held); every lasso is the registration of a world held by a list (lasso_realized). With the lasso hypotheses in diagonal order (lassos, pairAt, pairAt_place): on a lasso course the learner is refuted at most tri (i + q) + q times, claims at every step from step i + q + 1 on and is not refuted at arbitrarily late steps (lasso_learner_bounded), and that from some step on it claims at every step and is right is unrefuted (rest_unrefuted, a double negation); where from some step on it claims at every step and is right, the course is a lasso (lasso_of_rest); where the orbit is held by a list l it is refuted fewer than tri l.length times, claims at every step from step l.length on and is not refuted at arbitrarily late steps (held_learner_bounded), its coming to rest unrefuted (held_rest_unrefuted); its diagonal course is no lasso (diagonal_not_lasso); that a bounded count that never falls is constant from some step on is unrefuted (stable_unrefuted). With classes G c merged along the pairs (merged), where G c j holds the learner over the merged enumeration has index at most tri (c + j) + j (merged_bound), and the learner over every merging is unrested on its diagonal course (merged_unrested). Witness: on Alternate (false, true, false, …) the learner is refuted twice and right at every step from the third (Alternate.index_three, Alternate.rests).

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- No axiom. Decidable equality of values (DecidableEq O) appears only as a condition of the learner (learning by refutation, the lasso learner, the merged learner and diagonal_not_lasso) and of swapTo (another value), and is used only in the proofs of claim_refuted_on_one and eq_of_not_refuted; no_record_fixes_next and diagonal_refutes, diagonal_unrested and diagonal_open do not use it (each is listed in the decidability inventory).
- Each theorem's conditions are written into it: two different values (no_record_fixes_next); other moving every value (the diagonal); some hypothesis holding (index_le_of_holds, refutations_not_recurring); the course being a lasso or the orbit held by a list (lasso_learner_bounded, held_learner_bounded). The hypotheses H and the classes G are supplied from outside the learning.
- Coming to rest is stated only as a double negation (rest_unrefuted, held_rest_unrefuted, stable_unrefuted), the names carrying “unrefuted” under the integrator's rule: the step of rest is not stated here (not shown impossible; P83 states it: where the orbit is held by a list of length N, the learner claims and is right at every step from N + (2N − 1)·tri N on, Identification.held_learner_rests, a step the bound gives and the learner's record does not show); “not refuted at arbitrarily late steps” is the negation of refutations recurring, not “unrefuted from some step on”.

On 12 October 2026 Ren asked how completely the meta level, artificial neural networks, cognition and the wisdom about learning are explained; to the AI's answer (none complete, induction undissolved) Ren replied “please, fully complete, 我觉得理更像是对结构和变化的规律的建模 finish wisdom root, and resolve the undissolved”. The AI reads it as completing the three proposed steps and resolving the problem of induction. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): induction is resolved into laws rather than certified; Hume's problem sits at no_record_fixes_next; learning by refutation is identification in the limit in Gold's sense, its rest unregistered; the meta level is learning again, with no top (the reading of merged_unrested); wisdom is never a completed learner.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 75 theorems of Becoming.Learning all have empty axiom reports, among them no_record_fixes_next, claim_refuted_on_one, diagonal_refutes, diagonal_open, index_le_of_holds, refutations_not_recurring, held_learner_bounded, held_rest_unrefuted and merged_unrested; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §92 of the integration note; there is no independent review yet.

Which hypotheses or classes an actual formation holds, whether its registration tells values apart and whether its world is held by a list are not derived; the bound tri N is coarse, not optimal; only determined, value-by-value learning is stated, and probabilistic or approximate learning (PAC), the general theory of countable classes and computational complexity are not; the main theorems are known results of learning theory (Putnam's 1963 diagonal, identification in the limit after Gold 1967 and Putnam 1965, Gold's enumeration method, Kelly 1996) in the spine's form, the delta being their integration with registration, experiment, mechanism and selection; the readings other than 理 are the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation; contains no ethical predicate.

- No learner rests on every course: the diagonal course refutes each of its claims (diagonal_unrested), and the lasso learner's diagonal course is no lasso (diagonal_not_lasso). <a id="依赖与关联-dependencies-and-related-results"></a>
## Dependencies and related results

- **formal-reuse**: [recurrence-without-premise](recurrence-without-premise.md). Reuses Law.orbit, Law.process, revisits_within (within finitely many configurations the orbit returns), unlisted_of_new (a law new at every step is held by no list), gap_of_le, gap_of_lt and mem_cons_split. The delta reads return off the registration: the registration of an orbit held by a list is a lasso, and the registration of a law keeping its record is the diagonal course.
- **interpretive**: [testing-within-registration](testing-within-registration.md). P49's Web.tail_unrefuted (without a model no finite record refutes a claim about what follows) is the same law for level histories; here it is stated for every course (no_record_fixes_next), with its positive side: in a world held by a list learning by refutation is refuted a bounded number of times.

**Output:** Within finitely many configurations the orbit returns; a law new at every step is held by no list.

**Input:** The registration of a world held by a list is a lasso; the diagonal course's world is open.

**Preserved conditions:** No premise; a determined law. [Recurrence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Recurrence.lean)


**Output:** A claim is refuted only through a registered difference; without a model the record refutes no claim about what follows.

**Input:** Refutation and learning on a course of registered values.

**Preserved conditions:** A registration that tells values apart (for learning by refutation). [Testing.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Testing.lean)

- Related, not a proved adapter: [experiment-needs-return](experiment-needs-return.md). There the record fixes an act's outcome only where taken; here the record fixes no next value, and a lasso's return is the return that lets learning come to rest.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [generalization-through-lumping](generalization-through-lumping.md). There, when a model of what is irrelevant is right; here, when learning that selects a model from the record comes to rest.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [scientific-inquiry-foundation](scientific-inquiry-foundation.md). The laws of induction are part of the necessary relations of scientific inquiry; this record does not prove the whole core indispensable to science.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [learnable-through-registration](learnable-through-registration.md). Where registration does not tell configurations apart: some learner rests at every configuration exactly where configurations with the same registered future have targets agreeing from some step on; the learner still tells registered values apart.
